feature: Trigger manual vHub (end-day, download, report) dan upload file ACK/NTL langsung lewat endpoint, diteruskan dari staff API lewat cron proxy
note: Pendukung interface vHub (OCMS35.2): tiga POST trigger yang mem-bypass flag enabled dan dua POST /v1/cron/vhub/ack|ntl/process yang menerima file multipart. Tidak ada story yang menyebut trigger manual. Proteksi akses lewat APIM tidak terlihat di repo.
note_en: Supports the vHub interface (OCMS35.2): three trigger POSTs that bypass the enabled flag and two POST /v1/cron/vhub/ack|ntl/process endpoints that accept a multipart file. No story mentions manual triggers. Access protection through APIM is not visible in the repo.

feature: Persiapan notifikasi vHub saat admin fee naik (prepareVhubNotification) yang hanya ditulis ke log
note: Admin fee job menyusun daftar notice untuk vHub tetapi baris 124 masih 'TODO: Send to vHub API when vHub integration is ready' dan hanya log debug. Pengiriman nyata terjadi lewat query outstanding end-day yang membandingkan amount_payable terakhir yang dikirim (OCMS35.2), jadi stub ini tidak mengirim apa pun dan tidak diklaim.
note_en: The admin fee job builds a list of notices for vHub but line 124 still says 'TODO: Send to vHub API when vHub integration is ready' and only writes debug logs. Actual sending happens through the end-day outstanding query, which compares the last sent amount_payable (OCMS35.2), so this stub sends nothing and is not claimed.
